title: test(service-automation): sealed-envelope pin no longer matches short fixture strings against random ciphertext

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCRAyW1nbzvK9mcvgPRf542)_

Fixes #30957

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改一个测试文件。密封信封钉子的夹具值都换成带 `.` 的长字符串，并加一条断言：存进 KV 的信封里一个 `.` 都没有。
- 为什么改：原夹具连接器名是 `crm`，随机 base64url 密文大约每 1,100 次运行就会碰巧含有它，`Test Core` 在无关 PR 上偶发变红。
- 风险与回滚：只动测试，不动生产代码、不发布；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts` 中 sealed 那一组 describe 的 `begun` 夹具与第一条用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ADR-0143 D5 — a begun connect is held sealed` in `service-automation`'s `oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts`:

- The describe's `begun` fixture now gives every plaintext field the pin looks for (connector, organization, user, verifier, redirect URI) and the state a value that carries a `.`. Neither base64url nor the envelope's JSON frame (`{"v":1,"iv":…,"ct":…,"tag":…}`) ever emits a `.`, so random `iv` / `ct` / `tag` text can never contain one of those values by chance.
- The pin asserts that precondition (every looked-for value contains `.`) and that the stringified stored envelope contains no `.` at all, then keeps the per-field `not.toContain` loop and the `['ct', 'iv', 'tag', 'v']` key check.

What the pin proves is unchanged: if the store writes any plaintext field into the KV, it goes red (ablation below). The short `org_a` / `usr_1` values the card also names are replaced in this describe as well. Test only, so no changeset (the file is not in the package's `files`; `skip-changeset`).

Siblings checked (`grep -rn "not.toContain" packages/services/service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/`): the other hits match fixed strings against error messages (`app-credential`, `grant-handle`, `mcp-authorization`, `token-endpoint`), or `'raw-state-value'` against a fixed prefix plus a hex SHA-256 digest (`authorization.test.ts`, the KV-key pin). None matches a short value against random text, so none shares the flake; no other file changed.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 11 passed.

<details><summary>Ablation (one leg): the store writes the plaintext connector beside the envelope</summary>

Via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `src/oauth2-grant/authorization.ts`, `kvPendingAuthorizationStore().put` changed from `sealPendingAuthorization(state, pending)` to `{ ...sealPendingAuthorization(state, pending), connector: pending.connector }`:

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 75c236c59f8b -> aa62fda5748e
     × the KV holds no verifier, user, organization, instance or redirect URI — only an envelope 7ms
 FAIL  src/oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts > ADR-0143 D5 — a begun connect is held sealed (the KV trust boundary) > the KV holds no verifier, user, organization, instance or redirect URI — only an envelope
AssertionError: expected '{"v":1,"iv":"Lzv2WBDpLmRysSC_","ct":"…' not to contain '.'
      Tests  1 failed | 10 passed (11)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (75c236c59f8b) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The test imports `./authorization.js` from source, so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The new `expect(stored).not.toContain('.')` is deterministic: the envelope is `v` (the number 1) plus three base64url strings inside a JSON frame, none of which can emit `.`. If the envelope format ever gains a field that may hold a `.`, this line goes red and the fixture choice needs revisiting, which is the intended signal.
